convert_torchvision_to_d2: run the script to convert a torchvision ResNet .pth model file to Detectron2 .pkl format
rename_layer_keys: run the script to rename torchvision layer keys like layer1 to res2 and bn1 to conv1.norm
detach_and_numpy: run the script to detach tensors and convert them to numpy arrays for pickle serialization
check_unconverted_keys: run the script and print any unconverted keys that were not mapped to Detectron2 naming
review_weight_conversion: review the script to understand how torchvision ResNet weights are remapped to Detectron2 format
